Most are central and easy to get around. Starting from around ฿500–1,500/night.
introH2: 🏙️ Why does choosing the right base in Udon Thani matter?
introHtml: Udon Thani, the hub of upper Isan, has a compact centre — nearly everything sits within the municipal area, a few minutes apart. Central Plaza and Prajak Sillapakhom Road is the shopping-and-hotel quarter. UD Town is the community mall in front of the railway station, with a market and evening food. Nong Prajak Park is the lake in the centre of town, good for a stroll or a jog. And the Mak Khaeng quarter is the old heart of the city, full of shops and design hotels. Many people come to Udon to connect onward to Nong Khai or Laos, or to break the journey before visiting Kham Chanot or the Red Lotus Sea, then book without checking whether they're near what they came for. This guide rounds up 10 Udon Thani hotels we've picked across every tier — from high-scoring design boutiques to a luxury hotel by Central, down to value hostels — each with an honest take from real reviews, prices compared on 3 sites, and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Udon Thani has no metro, but the city is compact — a Grab or a songthaew is cheap and easy. From Udon Thani Airport (UTH) it's about 10–15 minutes into town, and there's a railway station in front of UD Town for those arriving by train. The main areas in this guide: Prajak Sillapakhom Road · Central Plaza — shopping, central hotels, walkable to a lot · UD Town · railway station — the community mall, market, evening food · Mak Khaeng quarter — the old heart, shops, design hotels · Nong Prajak — the lake in the city centre, lakeside stays · Nittayo Road — the route out to Nong Khai and the airport.

entries.name: Hotel MOCO
entries.revCount: 296 reviews · highest score in this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thong Yai Rd · near UD Town
entries.addr: 56 Thong Yai Rd, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani
entries.storyHtml: The highest score in this list at 9.6 across 296 reviews — Hotel MOCO is an art-deco design boutique near UD Town that sells itself on attention to detail, on Thong Yai Road in the heart of the Mak Khaeng quarter. Rooms have a warm, distinctive fit-out, and Executive rooms and up come with a JBL speaker and a Nespresso machine. It's a short walk to UD Town and the railway station. Real reviews praise the design, the cleanliness, the comfy beds and the attentive staff — a fit for those who want a design room in the city at an accessible price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Step up to an Executive room for the JBL speaker and Nespresso machine — only a little more than the Deluxe, worth it if you like the details — and being near UD Town, it's an easy walk out for evening food.
pros: Highest score in the list, 9.6 across 296 reviews
Art-deco design with a distinctive room fit-out
Executive rooms have a JBL speaker and a Nespresso machine
Thong Yai Road location, a walk to UD Town and the station
cons: A small boutique — fewer facilities than a big hotel
Popular rooms fill fast on weekends, so book ahead

entries.name: Centara Udon
entries.revCount: 1,326 reviews · the most-reviewed in this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Prajak Sillapakhom Rd · attached to Central Plaza
entries.addr: 277/1 Prajak Sillapakhom Rd, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani
entries.storyHtml: Centara Udon is a 4-star luxury hotel with a convention centre, attached to Central Plaza, and the most-reviewed in this list with 1,326 reviews, scoring 9.2, part of the Centara group. The draw is a location that connects straight into Central Plaza — you walk into the mall — with a pool, gym and a convention centre used for seminars and large banquets. It's a fit for conference-goers, families and anyone who wants easy shopping. Real reviews praise the mall-side location, the chain-standard service, the breakfast and the ample parking, even if the building opened in 2009 and some corners are showing their age.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a high floor on the city-view side for a brighter, quieter room, and the Central Plaza location means you can walk into the mall to shop and find food without calling a car.
pros: The most-reviewed in the list, 1,326 reviews — lots of real data
Attached to Central Plaza — walk straight into the mall
Has a pool, gym and a large convention centre
Chain-standard service, ample parking
cons: The building opened in 2009; some corners show their age
During big conferences or banquets the lobby and car park get busy

entries.name: Civilize Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pho Si Rd · Mak Khaeng, near Central
entries.addr: 396/28 Pho Si Rd, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani
entries.storyHtml: Civilize Hotel is a central design boutique in the Mak Khaeng quarter that scores a high 9.4 across 358 reviews. It sits on Pho Si Road, near Central Plaza — easy for shopping and finding food. The draw is a warm-toned design and rooms that start at 32 sqm, larger than the in-town norm, with both family rooms and a junior suite for longer stays. Real reviews praise the fit-out, the cleanliness, the room size and the friendly service — a fit for those who want a boutique feel in the city centre.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a group or with kids, the Family or the 48 sqm Grand Deluxe beats booking several rooms, and the Pho Si Road location is a walk to Central and the restaurants.
pros: A high-scoring design boutique, 9.4 across 358 reviews
Rooms from 32 sqm — larger than the in-town norm
Family rooms and a junior suite for longer stays
Pho Si Road location, near Central Plaza, walkable to shop
cons: Starting price a little above in-town hotels of the same class
A boutique — fewer facilities than a big hotel

entries.name: VELA Dhi Udon Thani
entries.addr: 471 Adunyadet Rd, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani
entries.storyHtml: VELA Dhi is an adults-only lifestyle hotel with an aviation theme, heavily reviewed with 1,076 reviews, scoring 9.2. It sits on Adunyadet Road, near UD Town and the city centre. The draw is the aviation concept with a modern, minimalist white fit-out, and being adults-only it keeps a quiet, private feel. Rooms start at 28 sqm, from standard rooms up to a corner suite. Real reviews praise the design, the cleanliness, the quiet and the location near the food spots — a fit for couples or anyone who wants privacy.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: It's an adults-only hotel that leans into quiet — good for couples or solo travellers; families with young kids should pick elsewhere in this list — and the 35 sqm Deluxe is only a few hundred baht more.
pros: Heavily reviewed (1,076) with a 9.2 score
Aviation-themed, adults-only, modern minimalist white design
Adults-only, so a quiet and private feel
Adunyadet Road location, near UD Town and the food spots
cons: Adults-only — families with young kids can't stay
The 28 sqm Superior is compact; size up for a group

entries.name: Banbua Grand Udon Hotel
entries.revCount: 170 reviews · boutique with a pool, central
entries.badge: 🏊 Boutique with a pool, great value
entries.mrtTag: 📍 City centre · between Central and UD Town
entries.addr: Soi Samphanthamit, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani
entries.storyHtml: Banbua Grand is a great-value city boutique starting at just ฿1,000, yet scoring a high 9.4 across 170 reviews. It sits on Soi Samphanthamit, central, between Central Plaza and UD Town. The draw is a swimming pool — rare at this price — with a contemporary design, balconies in some rooms and pool-view rooms. It's a tidy choice for those who want a boutique with a pool in the centre without paying big-hotel rates. Real reviews praise the cleanliness, the fit-out, the pool and the value.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a few hundred baht more, the Pool View room overlooks the pool and has a private balcony — worth it — and the central location means a quick Grab to Central or UD Town.
pros: A high-scoring city boutique, 9.4 across 170 reviews
Has a pool — rare from a ฿1,000 starting price
Contemporary design, some rooms with a balcony and pool view
Central location, between Central and UD Town
cons: A small boutique — fewer facilities than a big hotel
Down a soi — check the map the first time you arrive

entries.name: De Princess Hotel Udon Thani
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nittayo Rd · Nong Bua, central city
entries.addr: 135/135 Moo 14, Nittayo Rd, Nong Bua, Mueang Udon Thani
entries.storyHtml: De Princess is a 3-star boutique hotel that opened in 2019 and scores a high 9.3 across 168 reviews. It sits on Nittayo Road in Nong Bua — the route out to Nong Khai and the airport, but still in town. The draw is a newer hotel with clean white-toned rooms, standard rooms from 32 sqm, and a range from suites up to a penthouse for longer stays or special occasions, plus parking. Real reviews praise the freshness, the cleanliness, the room size and the service — a fit for those who want a new room and for those driving themselves.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're driving or continuing to Nong Khai, the Nittayo Road location is easy for getting out of town and has parking, and the 45 sqm Sapphire Suite is worth it for a multi-night stay.
pros: A boutique that opened in 2019 — fresh rooms, 9.3 score
Standard rooms from 32 sqm with a white-toned design
Suites in several sizes for longer stays and families
Has parking; easy to head out toward Nong Khai
cons: On Nittayo Road heading out of town, farther from Central than the central hotels
A 3-star — no pool or big-hotel services

entries.name: Kavinburi Green Hotel
entries.revCount: 151 reviews · near the railway station, UD Town
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Prajak Sillapakhom Rd · UD Town area
entries.addr: 299/99 Prajak Sillapakhom Rd, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani
entries.storyHtml: Kavinburi Green is a great-value 3-star in the UD Town area, a walk from Udon's railway station, scoring 8.9 across 151 reviews. It sits on Prajak Sillapakhom Road near UD Town and the station — a fit for those arriving by train or who want to be near the market and evening food. The draw is tidy, modern rooms, some with a balcony, from just ฿1,000. Real reviews praise the cleanliness, the location near the station and UD Town, and the value — a fit for travellers focused on location and a tight budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Arriving by train or connecting onward, this is a walk to the station and UD Town, and for a few hundred baht more the Superior Balcony room feels airier.
pros: UD Town location, a walk to Udon's railway station
From just ฿1,000 — great value, 8.9 score
Tidy, modern rooms, some with a balcony
Near the market and evening food at UD Town
cons: A 3-star with basic facilities — no pool
The station area gets fairly busy during the day

entries.name: Prajaktra Design Hotel
entries.revCount: 60 reviews · boutique by Nong Prajak lake
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Supakitchanya Rd · by Nong Prajak lake
entries.addr: Supakitchanya Rd, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani
entries.storyHtml: Prajaktra is a modern design boutique by Nong Prajak, the lake park in the centre of Udon, scoring 8.7 across 60 reviews. The draw is the lakeside location, where you can stroll or jog around the park, with some rooms looking onto the lake and a clean modern fit-out. Standard rooms start at around 30 sqm, from superior up to a design suite. It's a choice for those who want a quieter waterside feel than the big-road hotels, while still being in town. Real reviews praise the lakeside location, the design and the cleanliness.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a Design Suite that looks onto the lake for the full Nong Prajak effect, and an early-morning walk or cycle around the park is easy from here.
pros: Lakeside location by Nong Prajak, a stroll around the park
Modern design, some rooms with lake views
Rooms from around 30 sqm, several sizes to choose
A quieter waterside feel than the big-road hotels
cons: Fewer reviews (60) than other in-town hotels
By the lake — farther from Central and UD Town than the central hotels

entries.name: Napalai Hotel
entries.addr: 572 Pracharaksa Rd, Ban Lueam, Mueang Udon Thani
entries.storyHtml: Napalai is a great-value 3-star city hotel starting at just ฿790, near Central Plaza, scoring 8.4 across 140 reviews. It's a mid-size in-town hotel that travellers know, with rooms from a budget superior up to a Family Suite as large as 96 sqm for families. The central location reaches Central and the key spots easily, and it has parking. Real reviews praise the value, the location and the size of the family rooms — a fit for those focused on a low price and a central base.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a group or with kids, the Family Suite — up to 96 sqm — beats booking several rooms by a long way, and the central location means a quick Grab to Central.
pros: Cheap from ฿790, central location
Near Central Plaza and the key in-town spots
Has a Family Suite up to 96 sqm for families
Has parking, a fit for those driving themselves
cons: A standard 3-star, not a new design boutique
Lower score than other in-town picks — value is the main draw

entries.name: Top Hostel Udon Thani
entries.addr: 35/3 Samphanthamit Rd, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani
entries.storyHtml: Top Hostel is the best-scoring of the budget stays in this list, a private-room hostel at 8.5 across 123 reviews. It sits on Samphanthamit Road in the centre of Udon. The draw is a private-room hostel with AC, a fridge and an ensuite bathroom from just ฿500 — more privacy than a dorm, but still cheap. It ranges from a double up to a family room, a fit for solo travellers, couples or backpackers who want a clean central room on a budget. Real reviews praise the price, the cleanliness and the central location.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a group, the Family room sleeps three and beats booking several rooms, and the central location makes it easy to walk out for food and grab a Grab to Central.

faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Udon Thani hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in Udon Thani?
faq.a: Udon Thani is compact, with most things in town · Prajak Sillapakhom Road · Central Plaza suits shopping and walking to a lot (Centara, Civilize, Kavinburi) · UD Town · railway station suits arriving by train and the evening food market (Hotel MOCO, VELA Dhi, Kavinburi) · By Nong Prajak lake suits a quieter waterside stay (Prajaktra) · Nittayo Road suits drivers or those continuing to Nong Khai (De Princess) · A Grab gets you between all of them easily.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Udon Thani hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: hostels and budget stays from about ฿500 a night · 3-star in-town hotels around ฿790–1,300 · 4-star design boutiques around ฿1,000–1,500 · upper-tier hotels and lifestyle stays from about ฿1,200–1,500 · During festivals, the Red Lotus Sea season, or busy stopover periods on the way to Laos, prices rise and rooms fill fast.

faq.q: ❓ Do I need a vehicle in Udon Thani?
faq.a: Not within the city, since most key spots are close together and a Grab or songthaew gets you around easily · It's about 10–15 minutes from Udon Thani Airport into town, and there's a central railway station in front of UD Town · But to head out of town — to Kham Chanot, the Red Lotus Sea at Nong Han Kumphawapi, or Ban Chiang — renting a car is far more convenient and flexible.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book an Udon Thani hotel?
faq.a: For ordinary weekdays, booking 1–2 weeks ahead is fine · But during festivals (such as the Thung Sri Mueang fair in early Dec and Songkran), plus the Red Lotus Sea season (Dec–Feb) when many travellers come and break the journey on to Laos, in-town hotels fill up fast and prices rise — book 2–4 weeks ahead or more.

faq.q: ❓ Should I stay near the station/UD Town or near Central?
faq.a: Staying near UD Town and the railway station suits arriving by train, connecting onward, or wanting the market and evening food (Hotel MOCO, VELA Dhi, Kavinburi) · Staying near Central Plaza suits shopping and walking straight into the mall (Centara, Civilize) · Both are in town and a Grab apart in minutes, so pick the area closest to what you came for if you're mostly exploring in town.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Udon Thani hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion and period, so we recommend opening all 3 to compare before every booking — each review page in this article gives you the price-comparison links, which can save several hundred baht a night.
